prompt:
Rewrite snippets/color-palette-chips.liquid so it renders a list of color swatch buttons with safe text and attribute escaping. Inputs (all supplied as variables; every key is always present): - palette (top-level object, never null) - palette.heading: string or null - palette.selected: string or null (the value of the chip that should appear selected) - palette.chips: array (may be empty) of objects, each with: - name: string or null - hex: string or null (a CSS color; never validated) - value: string or null "Trimmed" means leading/trailing whitespace removed; null counts as an empty string. Rules: 1. A chip is rendered only if its trimmed name is non-empty. Other chips are ignored entirely (they are not counted and cannot be selected). 2. Chip value: the trimmed value; if that is empty, the trimmed name lowercased with every single space character replaced by "-" (e.g. "Sea Green" -> "sea--green", "Sky & Sea" -> "sky-&-sea"). 3. Selection: let WANTED be the trimmed palette.selected. If WANTED is non-empty, the FIRST rendered chip whose chip value equals WANTED exactly (case-sensitive, compared before escaping) is selected. At most one chip is selected; later chips with the same value are not selected. 4. Each rendered chip outputs exactly:
    • where CLASSES is "palette__chip", followed by " palette__chip--empty" if the trimmed hex is empty, followed by " is-selected" if selected (in that order); PRESSED is true or false; NAME is the trimmed name; VALUE is the chip value. STYLE is present only when the trimmed hex is non-empty, as style="background-color: TRIMMED HEX" preceded by a single space after the aria-pressed attribute; otherwise there is nothing between aria-pressed="..." and >. 5. Wrapper, only if at least one chip is rendered:
    , then

    TRIMMED HEADING

    only when the trimmed heading is non-empty, then
      CHIPS
    , then

    N colors

    where N is the number of rendered chips and the word is "color" when N is 1, otherwise "colors", then
    . If no chip is rendered, output an empty string. 6. Every inserted string (heading, name, value, hex) is escaped with the core escape filter, in text and in attributes alike: & < > " ' become & < > " '. Existing entities are escaped again ("R&D" outputs "R&D"); do not use escape_once. 7. No whitespace or newlines between or around tags; only the spaces shown above and those inside the inserted strings. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/color-palette-chips.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
